graham.brief:
There's a line on this game a long way from what the player has actually done. The books have Tyler Shough at 33.5 pass attempts, well below the 45 he's averaging. They're buying the new version of him.

New Orleans plays fast, 2nd-most plays a game. Las Vegas plays slow, 5th-fewest plays a game. When everybody agrees, I get suspicious, so I went to the props.

New Orleans leans on play-action, and Las Vegas has been hard to fool with it. Travis Etienne is part of a committee who's played 56% of the snaps.

Here's the price, and it reads the same way I do. New Orleans is favored by 3.5 with a 44 total. I get nothing decisive here either, same as the price. Shough's line has crept up all week, so the books may be expecting New Orleans to be chasing. A possession or two where New Orleans stops splitting the difference would answer it.
